text: 国庆长假期间，市场并不平静。10年期美债收益率一度升破5.34%，创24年新高。但高利率阴云之下，外资对中国资产的关注度却不降反升。
text_en: During the National Day holiday, the market was not calm. The 10-year US Treasury yield once rose above 5.34%, a 24-year high. But under the dark cloud of high interest rates, foreign investors' attention to Chinese assets rose rather than fell.
